title: Analyzing Error Propagation in Korean Spoken QA with ASR-LLM Cascades
abstract: arXiv:2605.17443v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We analyze how automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors propagate through ASR--LLM cascades in Korean spoken question answering (SQA), focusing on downstream semantic failures that conventional ASR metrics cannot fully capture. Our analysis shows that the relative downstream degradation caused by ASR errors is consistent across LLMs with different absolute performance, suggesting that cascade degradation largely tracks ASR-stage information loss. We further identify single-character ASR errors as a particularly salient source of information loss in Korean, where even a minimal transcription difference can change the intended question and degrade downstream QA performance. Finally, an auxiliary comparison shows that a large audio language model outperforms an ASR--LLM cascade with an approximately matched language backbone in noisy Korean SQA, indicating the potential of direct audio input to mitigate transcript-induced information l

translated_title: 韩语口语问答中ASR-LLM级联系统的错误传播分析
translated_abstract: 我们分析了自动语音识别（ASR）错误如何在韩语口语问答（SQA）中通过ASR-LLM级联系统传播，重点关注传统ASR指标无法完全捕捉的下游语义失败。我们的分析表明，由ASR错误引起的相对下游性能下降在不同绝对性能的LLM之间保持一致，这表明级联系统的性能下降主要跟随ASR阶段的信息损失。我们进一步发现，单个字符的ASR错误是韩语中信息损失的一个特别显著的来源，即使是最小的转录差异也可能改变预期问题并降低下游问答性能。最后，一项辅助比较显示，在嘈杂的韩语SQA环境中，一个大型音频语言模型优于具有大致匹配语言骨干的ASR-LLM级联系统，这表明直接音频输入有潜力减轻转录引起的信息损失。
tldr: 本研究揭示了韩语口语问答中ASR错误通过级联系统传播的规律，指出单字符转录错误是信息损失的关键来源，并证明大型音频语言模型在噪声环境下优于传统ASR-LLM级联。
en_tdlr: This study reveals how ASR errors propagate through cascades in Korean spoken QA, identifies single-character transcription errors as a key source of information loss, and demonstrates that large audio language models outperform ASR-LLM cascades in noisy conditions.
